whatThisIs: Offers several forms of support, such as the Peer Mentor Program, Chatting with Experts, Support Navigators and Lived Experience Specialists, and help finding a provider who specializes in perinatal mental health.
whoItHelps: Perinatal (close to birth or in postpartum) individuals/moms looking for mental health support.
whatToKnow: The Peer Mentor Program matches you with another person recovering from perinatal mental health disorders. Alongside trained volunteers who have lived through and recovered from similar experiences, they help create a peer-to-peer environment.

In Chat(s) with an Expert, you can talk with a PSI expert about symptoms, resources, treatment options, and more. PSI experts are licensed mental health professionals and can be contacted by phone. These chats are organized into two groups: moms and dads.
SNs, specialists, and “Help Find a Provider” help you find qualified local individuals.
name: Help for Perinatal Individuals
